create_s3_bucket: create an S3 bucket in a specified AWS region using the S3Gateway class
upload_download_s3_file: upload or download a file to or from an S3 bucket with progress tracking
list_s3_objects: list all objects under a given prefix in an S3 bucket using pagination
copy_s3_object: copy an S3 object from a source bucket and key to a destination bucket and key
get_s3_bucket_policy: get the policy statements and public access block configuration for an S3 bucket
